slug: 2024-03-25 Data Protection Law Now In Force In Seychelles

facts.fact: Appleby reports the Data Protection Act 2023, introduced in December 2023, is in force and repeals the 2003 Act, with all controllers and processors given an 18-month transitional period from 22 December 2023 to conform (as_of is the document's published date).

Appleby states the Information Commission of Seychelles is designated as the competent authority to enforce the Act, with powers to audit, investigate and impose penalties; it does not say the Commission is already acting under the Act (as_of is the published date).
